text:
evan_ae: Quick sync with Jordan from Contoso — they want a 2-week Private POC but their corporate stack only allows outbound via a proxy that enforces HTTP CONNECT to port 443. They asked: PrivateLink vs peering, minimal firewall/NAT changes, and a rough POC cost for 4 vGPU-equivalents.

lia_se: TL;DR: PrivateLink preferred for locked-down envs (no route changes). But if their proxy prevents direct ENI IPs, they'll need an in-VPC NAT/proxy that can CONNECT to our NLB.

omar_net: Topology options:
- PrivateLink (interface endpoints to our NLB backed service) — no peering/route exchange.
- VPC peering / Transit GW — full L3, but needs peering approvals and route updates.
- PrivateLink + small NAT inside customer VPC (recommended when corporate proxy blocks ENI IPs).

clara_sec: Security primers for POC:
- All comms TLS 1.2+ on 443. mTLS for control plane available on request.
- We can publish per-deployment control/data-plane CIDRs for allowlisting.
- Private deployments support customer KMS and audit log export.

jordan_cust: Our proxy only allows CONNECT to hostnames (SNI), not raw IPs. Can you provide hostnames we can whitelist?

lia_se: We provide hostnames for the control plane (api.redwood.<region>.internal) and NLB hostnames for data plane. If proxy supports SNI/hostname ACLs, they can whitelist those. If not, the NAT/proxy route is easiest.

omar_net: Minimal egress rules example to share with Contoso networking team:
```
# Control plane
Dest: api.redwood.<region>.internal (or 3.120.45.66/32)
Proto: TCP
Ports: 443

# Data plane (PrivateLink/NLB)
Dest: NLB hostnames or ENI CIDRs we provide per-region
Proto: TCP
Ports: 443
# Optional: ephemeral outbound if NAT used
Ports: 1024-65535 (only for client-initiated ephemeral sockets)
```
Keep allowlist narrow to hostnames/IPs we provide.

clara_sec: Add compliance notes: enable logging, TLS enforced, provide SOC mapping for POC. I'll attach short-form answers to their security questionnaire.

jordan_cust: Pricing? We need a ballpark to present to procurement for a 2-week trial.

lia_se: Rough estimate: shared-hosted POC (4vGPU class) ~ $DAILY_POC per day -> total ~ $DAILY_POC * 14. Dedicated reserved capacity requires monthly commit and has lower unit cost; private deployment onboarding has a one-time setup fee. I'll send exact numbers in DM.

opsbot: Ticket created: INF-4399 - Contoso POC proxy-only egress. Assigned: lia_se, omar_net, clara_sec. ETA 24h.

evan_ae: Thanks — next step: lia/omar/clara to produce a 1-pager with hostnames/IPs, minimal firewall rules, and the POC price by EOD tomorrow. Jordan will confirm whether they can whitelist hostnames or prefer NAT. :thumbsup:

lia_se: on it.

omar_net: will generate endpoint hostnames and sample SGs.

clara_sec: will prepare questionnaire answers.

jordan_cust: We'll try to get the proxy team to whitelist SNI hostnames first. If not, DevOps can stand up a NAT in our VPC. Thanks! :pray:
